createDialog.title: Create Backup
createDialog.description: This will start creating a new backup using the default storage.

restoreDialog.title: Restore backup?
restoreDialog.description: This will restore {{name}}. Existing data may be overwritten.

fileEditor.defaultDescription: Choose a file from the Files tab to open it here.
fileEditor.readOnlyNotice: You have read-only file access for this server.

noFileSelected.title: No file selected
noFileSelected.description: Open a file from the Files tab to view or edit it.

directorySelected.title: Directory selected
directorySelected.description: Directories cannot be opened in the editor.

archiveDisabled.title: Archive editing is disabled
archiveDisabled.description: This file is an archive. Download or extract it from the Files tab instead of editing it as text.

networkPorts.description: Every port exposed for this server. Raw ports are reached by host and port, HTTP ports through a route.

routes.title: Routes
routes.description: Point a subdomain at one of this server's ports.
routes.subdomainInvalid: Only lowercase letters, digits and dashes are allowed.

empty.noDomains: No domains are available for this project yet.
empty.noRoutablePorts: None of this server's ports can be routed yet.

manualDns.title: Point your own domain here
manualDns.description: The records to drop into your own DNS to reach a port. Pick the port and copy them over.
manualDns.noPorts: This server has no ports yet.
manualDns.createRouteFirst: Create a route for this port first — your own domain then points at it.
manualDns.replaceHelp: Replace your-domain with the name you own.
manualDns.httpHelp: An HTTP port is served through the reverse proxy, so your domain points at the route's address.
manualDns.nonHttpHelp: Clients that look the service up find the port on their own, so nobody has to type it.

dialog.title: New route
dialog.description: Pick a subdomain, the domain it lives under and the port it points at.
dialog.httpRouteHelp: An HTTP port becomes a reverse-proxied resource on the subdomain.
dialog.rawRouteHelp: A raw port gets an SRV record on the subdomain.
dialog.noSelectablePorts: This domain cannot carry any of this server's ports yet.
dialog.httpsHelpOff: This domain does not offer HTTPS.
dialog.createsRecordHelp: Creates {{record}}, so clients that look the service up reach the port on their own. The service name comes from the port.

deleteDialog.title: Delete route
deleteDialog.description: {{fqdn}} stops resolving and its records are removed from the provider.

sftp.title: SFTP Access
sftp.description: Use your daemon password for SFTP password auth, or configure SSH public key auth from your profile.
sftp.helpText: Your SFTP password is the daemon password shown in your settings. You can also add SSH public keys there.

wipe.title: Wipe Server Files
wipe.description: Deletes every file on the server. The next start recreates the template's files from scratch. Stop the server first.
wipe.dialogDescription: This deletes every file of the server, including worlds and configs. This action cannot be undone.
wipe.backupCheckboxHelp: The wipe is cancelled if the backup fails, so the files are never deleted without it.

toasts.wipeFailed: Failed to wipe the server files
toasts.wipeSuccessWithBackup: Backup started and server files wiped
